# Klazify

The most accurate Content Classification API. Categorize websites into 385+ topic categories with confidence scores, extract logos, social media links, company information, and technology stack data.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/klazify/.

## Actions

- **Categorize URL** (read-only): Retrieve IAB and Klazify category classifications for a specified domain or URL with confidence scores.
- **Get Company Data** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive company information for a specified domain including business data, location, employee count, revenue, funding, and…
- **Get Domain Logo** (read-only): Obtain the logo URL associated with a given domain.
- **Get Similar Companies** (read-only): Identify companies similar to the specified domain by analyzing category and target market.
- **Get Social Media Links** (read-only): Retrieve the list of social media links for a given domain.
- **Get Tech Stack** (read-only): Retrieve the technological stack utilized by a website including frameworks, platforms, and services.
- **Real Time Categorization** (read-only): Perform real-time website categorization with immediate AI-powered analysis and classification.
- **Get Domain Expiration** (read-only): Retrieve domain registration and expiration information for a specified domain.
